test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the total number of employees in 4 different companies.

What is the sum of female employees of company Q and company S?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a223e5c9bf16442e299199fc9200784aafffcdd951ba91a5af8e7a34ac259f3.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Female in Q = 1240 - 350 = 890

Female in S = 825 - 340 = 485

According to the question:

Sum = 890 + 485 = 1375

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
